item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/news/ai-wire-harness-quoting-europe","version_id":"3f0b6128cabb2c363faca5fff7b5511c50c36083101892f525858da4428f081b","decision":"accept","reason":"This is a fresh commercial manufacturing-design development: Cableteque says its platform automates wire-harness BOM extraction, quoting, sourcing, and procurement workflows for European manufacturers. The dated, quotable announcement is relevant as an attributed startup claim and adds a commercial perspective, but it does not disclose an accuracy, manufacturability, cost, or quote-speed evaluation; a customer-visible workflow test with stated inputs and outcomes would verify those capability claims.
